fret.definition:
n. agitation resulting from active worry
n. an ornamental pattern consisting of repeated vertical and horizontal lines (often in relief)
n. a small bar of metal across the fingerboard of a musical instrument; when the string is stopped by a finger at the metal bar it will produce a note of the desired pitch
v. be agitated or irritated
fret.translation:
n. 烦躁, 磨损, 焦急, 网状饰物
vi. 烦恼, 不满, 磨损
vt. 使烦恼, 腐蚀, 使磨损, 使起波纹

fret out.translation: 磨损,侵蚀;在烦躁中度过…

fret saw.translation: [机] 镂锯, 钢丝锯, 线锯

fretful.translation: a. 烦燥的, 焦噪的, 起波纹的

fretfully.translation: adv. 烦躁不安地; 焦躁地, 焦急地

fretsaw.definition: n fine-toothed power saw with a narrow blade; used to cut curved outlines

frettage.translation: n. [军]炮尾环的退缩,[总称]炮尾环

fretted.definition:
a. having frets
s. having a pattern of fretwork or latticework
fretted.translation: a. 焦躁的, 腐蚀的

fretter.definition: n. One who, or that which, frets.
